name: Sinistcha
author: mingo
flavor_text: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home’s floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

abilities.name: Hide ‘n’ Sneak
abilities.effect: Prevent all effects of your opponent’s Pokémon’s attacks and Abilities done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Matcha Spin
attacks.effect: If you have 6 or more Pokémon that have the Hide ‘n’ Sneak Ability in your discard pile, place 4 damage counters on each of your opponent’s Pokémon.
